managePayments.heading: Payments
managePayments.state.not_connected.title: Not set up
managePayments.state.not_connected.body: Takes about 10 minutes. You will need your bank details and an identity document.
managePayments.state.requirements.title: Stripe is asking for your details
managePayments.state.requirements.body: Card payments will not work until the Stripe company has your business and bank details.
managePayments.state.pending.title: Connected — Stripe is checking your details
managePayments.state.pending.body: You do not need to do anything. Stripe is reviewing what you sent; when they finish, this page will update.
managePayments.state.ready.title: Connected
managePayments.state.ready.body: Your Stripe account is connected and ready to accept payments.
managePayments.state.restricted.title: Card payments have been paused
managePayments.state.restricted.body: Until a matter is resolved, Stripe has paused card payments on your account.
managePayments.state.unsupported.title: Card payments are not available on this account
managePayments.state.unsupported.body: Stripe cannot enable card payments here. Contact us and we will sort it out together with you.
managePayments.keyMismatch.title: Stripe keys do not match
managePayments.keyMismatch.body: This site’s server uses the {server, select, live {live} other {test}} Stripe key; but the browser part was built with the {browser, select, live {live} other {test}} key. Card payments would fail at the very moment a customer tries to pay; so Stripe setup is blocked until the two match.
managePayments.keyMismatch.fix: Both keys must be set for the same environment, and after that the site must be rebuilt — the publishable key is embedded at build time; the secret key is read on every request.
managePayments.permission.title: Only the food truck owner can set up payments
managePayments.permission.body: The owner of the bank account the money is credited to must make the Stripe connection; so it has to be set up from their own logged-in account. There is nothing wrong with this food truck account or with the HatchGrab service.
managePayments.config.keyMissingTitle: Card payments are not configured yet
managePayments.config.fetchTitle: Could not check this food truck account’s Stripe account
managePayments.config.keyMissing: {name} is not set — the embedded components cannot be loaded.
managePayments.errors.unreachable: Could not reach the Stripe service
managePayments.online.heading: Online payments
managePayments.online.body: Customers pay by card when they order. The money goes straight to your own Stripe account — we never hold it.
managePayments.online.feeLine: Stripe charges {fee} for each payment made with standard {region}. Other cards may cost more. HatchGrab’s own fee on online orders depends on your plan — see the “Billing” section.
managePayments.online.testMode: Test mode. Real payments cannot be accepted yet.
managePayments.trialNote: Setting this up does not start your subscription, and nothing is charged to you today. This is how your customers pay you — your plan is separate.
managePayments.admin.title: You are viewing as platform admin
managePayments.admin.body: This food truck account has not set up online payments. Only the owner can start it, from their own logged-in account — there is nothing to press here.
managePayments.toast.addDetails: Now add the details Stripe asks for
managePayments.onboarding.restricted: Stripe will take care of it from here — you will log in on the Stripe site and update the details it asks for.
managePayments.onboarding.firstRun: Stripe will take care of it from here — you will log in on the Stripe site and provide your business and bank details.
managePayments.details.title: Your Stripe details
managePayments.details.body: Change the bank account the money is paid into, or update your business details and documents.
managePayments.walkUp.heading: Walk-up payments
managePayments.walkUp.body: How you take money at the food truck. Whichever you choose, HatchGrab charges no platform fee on walk-up orders.
managePayments.walkUp.ownTerminalHelp: Zettle, Square or whatever you already use. Nothing to set up — only your service provider’s own fees apply.
managePayments.walkUp.hatchgrabHelp: Uses the same Stripe connection as your online payments — a card machine, or contactless payment straight from your mobile phone or tablet.
managePayments.walkUp.hatchgrabFees: {fee} for each payment with {region}; plus an extra {surcharge} for contactless payments taken on a mobile phone or tablet. Other cards may cost more.
manageCharges.heading: Tax, tips, fees
manageCharges.rate.label: Sales tax rate
manageCharges.rate.hint: The rate you charge on every order. Customers will see it added on the payment page, on receipts and on tickets.
manageCharges.rate.regionDefault: If left empty, {label} {rate}% will be charged — this is the rate for prepared food in the {region} area.
manageCharges.included.label: Included in prices: {label}
manageCharges.included.hint: Your prices already include {label}. This rate only shows how much of each price is {label}, on receipts and tickets — nothing is added on the payment page.
manageCharges.included.default: If left empty, {rate}% will be used — this is the {label} rate for hot food sold as takeaway in the country {country}.
manageCharges.tips.label: Tips (tips)
manageCharges.tips.hint: Customers paying online by card can add a tip. All of it is yours.
manageCharges.fee.label: Online service fee
manageCharges.fee.hint: Added to online orders only. Never on “Pay at the truck” orders or walk-up orders. It is yours.
manageCharges.fee.example: Customers will see it as a single line before they pay: “{label} {amount}”.
manageCharges.fee.hatchgrab: HatchGrab adds a {fee} service fee to your customers’ online orders. You do not pay it, and cannot change it either.
manageCharges.saveFailed: Could not save — please try again.
takingPayment.heading: Taking payment
takingPayment.intro: How your team records the money for each order.
takingPayment.paidStepHelp: Adds a “Confirm” button when you add an order yourself; so you can place the order now and take payment later. Switch this on if you accept phone or advance orders.
takingPayment.paidStepNote: This only affects orders you add. It does not affect online orders.

weeklyPost.setup.pictureNote: Your picture with no date or place on it. We add those.

weeklyPost.post.privateHint: They are shown as “Private event” with the date and times — the place is never shown.
weeklyPost.post.noteHint: Shown in the caption, and in the note box too if you have placed one.

manageWhatsApp.preview.title: Test it before you connect
manageWhatsApp.preview.intro: Type a question the way a customer would ask, and see exactly what reply they would get. Nothing is sent to anyone.
manageWhatsApp.preview.noReplyWhy: That looks like an unwanted message (spam), a booking request or something unrelated; so the auto-reply stays quiet.
manageWhatsApp.preview.footnote: AI creates the replies; they differ slightly each time, and may sometimes be wrong.
manageWhatsApp.preview.failed: Could not create a preview right now.
manageWhatsApp.preview.unreachable: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
manageWhatsApp.setup.popupHint: Can’t see the Facebook window? It may have been blocked. Allow pop-up windows for the hatchgrab.com site, then press “Start again”.
manageWhatsApp.notice.sdkUnavailable: WhatsApp setup is not available in this environment.
manageWhatsApp.notice.sdkBlocked: Could not load Meta’s login script. Usually an ad blocker or tracking protection is the cause.
manageWhatsApp.notice.setupFailed: Setup could not be completed. Nothing was changed.
manageWhatsApp.notice.metaError: Meta reported a problem during setup. Nothing was changed. Try again; if this keeps happening, contact us.
manageWhatsApp.notice.closed: Setup was closed before it finished. Nothing was changed — press “Set up” to try again.
manageWhatsApp.notice.disconnectedUnreac: WhatsApp has been disconnected. Could not contact the Meta service to remove access. Remove HatchGrab’s access yourself in WhatsApp Business → Settings → Account → Business Platform.
manageWhatsApp.notice.disconnected: WhatsApp has been disconnected. Auto-replies have stopped.
manageWhatsApp.card.title: Auto-replies
manageWhatsApp.card.description: Answer customer questions automatically on your social media, using your menu and schedule.
manageWhatsApp.card.requiresAccount: A WhatsApp Business account is needed.
manageWhatsApp.card.popupInstruction: A Facebook window will open to connect your WhatsApp Business account. If nothing appears, allow pop-up windows for the hatchgrab.com site in your browser, then press “Set up” again.
manageWhatsApp.card.switchedOff: WhatsApp auto-replies are switched off for your food truck account.
manageWhatsApp.card.expiring: Your WhatsApp connection must be renewed soon. To keep auto-replies running, press “Reconnect”.
manageWhatsApp.card.instagram: Auto-replies to Instagram direct messages. An Instagram professional account will be needed.
manageWhatsApp.card.messenger: Auto-replies to Facebook Messenger messages. A Facebook Page will be needed.
manageWhatsApp.blocked.title: Your replies are not being delivered
manageWhatsApp.blocked.body: Because of a billing problem on your WhatsApp Business account, WhatsApp is refusing to send your auto-replies. Customers can still message you, and you will see everything they send — but they are not getting a reply.
manageWhatsApp.blocked.fix: You pay the WhatsApp company directly for these messages; so this is fixed on WhatsApp Manager. <link>Check your payment method</link>
manageWhatsApp.limit.heading: Auto-replies
manageWhatsApp.limit.label: Monthly limit
manageWhatsApp.limit.perCustomer: At most {n} replies per customer in 24 hours; after that, one message saying you will reply in person.
manageWhatsApp.limit.emailAt: Replies pause when the limit is reached. We will email you when usage reaches 80% and 100%.
manageWhatsApp.billing.heading: Charges
manageWhatsApp.billing.summary: It is Meta, not HatchGrab, that charges your WhatsApp account for replies. From {from}, the first {free, number} replies a month are free. Correct as of {checked}; for changes, see <link>Meta’s pricing details</link>.
manageWhatsApp.billing.chargesTitle: It is Meta, not HatchGrab, that charges for WhatsApp replies.
manageWhatsApp.billing.chargesBody: For each reply HatchGrab sends for you, Meta charges your WhatsApp Business account. From {from}, Meta gives {free, number} free replies a month for each number; after that, each reply is charged at Meta’s rate. Replies you send yourself from the WhatsApp Business app are not charged. Meta sets these prices and may also change them. <link>See Meta’s pricing details</link>
manageWhatsApp.billing.addPaymentInManag: Add a payment method on WhatsApp Manager
manageWhatsApp.billing.aboveMissing: Your limit is higher than the {free, number} free replies Meta gives. Without a payment method, once those run out Meta will stop all replies.
manageWhatsApp.billing.aboveGeneral: Your limit is higher than the {free, number} free replies Meta gives. Replies beyond that need a payment method on your WhatsApp account; without one, once the free replies run out Meta will stop all replies.
manageWhatsApp.disconnect.title: Disconnect WhatsApp?
manageWhatsApp.disconnect.body: Auto-replies stop immediately, and HatchGrab loses access to your WhatsApp account. Your number keeps working in the WhatsApp Business app. To remove HatchGrab’s access completely, also open WhatsApp Business → Settings → Account → Business Platform.
manageWhatsApp.signup.partial: We linked your WhatsApp Business account, but could not complete the connection. Nothing is wrong on your side — please contact us and we will complete it.
manageWhatsApp.signup.noNumber: Your WhatsApp Business account is linked, but no phone number was received. Press “Reconnect” and complete the number step.
manageWhatsApp.signup.needsRegistering: Your account is linked, but we must register this number before replies can start. Please contact the support team — your setup is saved, do not run it again.
manageWhatsApp.signup.registerRefused: Your account is linked, but Meta refused to register the number. Your setup is saved — contact the support team instead of running it again.
manageWhatsApp.signup.deliveryRefused: Your account is linked, but Meta refused to turn on message delivery. Your setup is saved — contact the support team instead of running it again.
manageWhatsApp.signup.numberTaken: That WhatsApp number is already connected to another HatchGrab account. A number can answer for only one food truck account. Contact the support team and we will move it across.
manageWhatsApp.signup.saveIncomplete: Almost done — could not finish saving. Your setup is saved; contact the support team instead of running it again.
manageWhatsApp.signup.connected: WhatsApp is connected. Auto-replies will start answering messages that come to this number.
customDomain.card.title: Add your schedule to your website
customDomain.card.create: We will create a page showing your schedule at the address <addr>{address}</addr>.
customDomain.card.justLive: {address} is working. Have a look at it, then tell us below that it is right.
customDomain.waiting.title: We are waiting: {address}
customDomain.waiting.bodySince: You set this up on {date}. New web addresses usually start working within a few minutes; sometimes it can take up to 24 hours to reach everyone — until then you do not need to do anything. If someone else was adding the line for you, it is worth checking whether they did it.
customDomain.waiting.body: New web addresses usually start working within a few minutes; sometimes it can take up to 24 hours to reach everyone — until then you do not need to do anything. If someone else was adding the line for you, it is worth checking whether they did it.
customDomain.ready.title: {address} is running
customDomain.ready.body: Have a look at it, then tell us in your settings that it is right.
customDomain.confirm.heading: Have a look, then tell us whether it is right
customDomain.confirm.checkTimes: Check that the dates and times are right.
customDomain.confirm.problemLine: Tell us what you are seeing, and we will look at it.
customDomain.confirmed.heading: Thanks — everything has been noted.
customDomain.confirmed.body: There is nothing else to do.
customDomain.turnOff.heading: Turn off your own web address?
customDomain.turnOff.carriesOn: This keeps running without any change; this is also where your QR code sends people:
customDomain.turnOff.reAdd: If you are going to set this up again later, leave the line you added at your web address company as it is. Otherwise, ask them to remove it.
customDomain.turnOff.failed: Could not turn it off right now. Nothing has changed — your address is still working. Try again shortly.
customDomain.wizard.resumeFailedBody: Nothing has changed. Try again shortly.
customDomain.wizard.resuming: Continuing from where you left off…
customDomain.address.intro: Your schedule gets its own web address.
customDomain.address.question: What is your web address?
customDomain.address.hint: The address people already use to find you.
customDomain.address.noChange: Your website does not change — you only need to add a link to the new address.
customDomain.address.notSetUp: We have not set this up.
customDomain.address.restricted: Whoever looks after your web address must allow us to set up the padlock — the small lock customers see beside the address. Until they add us it will not appear; so we have stopped here so you do not wait for it in vain. Ask them to add us, then try again.
customDomain.address.blocked: Your web address currently blocks the padlock completely. For this to work, whoever looks after it must allow it. Ask them to change that, then try again.
customDomain.address.elsewhere: Something is already running at that address. Send the message on the next screen to whoever looks after it — they will know what to do.
customDomain.address.provider: Your web address is looked after by: {provider}. We will show you where to go.
customDomain.address.provisionFailed: We could not set up that address.
customDomain.address.couldNotBeSetUp: That address could not be set up.
customDomain.apex.empty: Type the address you want to use.
customDomain.apex.not_a_domain: That does not look like a web address.
customDomain.apex.unparseable: Could not read that as a web address. Check the spelling and try again.
customDomain.apex.apex: {host} is your whole website address. If you point it at us, this page will appear instead of your website. Instead, add a word in front of it — for example events.{host}.
customDomain.apex.too_deep: That address has too many parts. Something like events.{domain} works best.
customDomain.record.addAtSave: Add this on the {provider} site, and save.
customDomain.record.addSomewhere: Add this where your web address is looked after, and save.
customDomain.record.hintWord: Only this word, not the whole address.
customDomain.record.timing: It usually starts working within an hour, though sometimes it can take longer. You do not need to keep this page open.
customDomain.record.someoneElse: Does someone else look after your web address?
customDomain.providers.cloudflare.open: Open your web address, then open “DNS” and “Records”.
customDomain.providers.cloudflare.name: Put the first value below in “Name”.
customDomain.providers.cloudflare.value: Put the second value below in “Target”.
customDomain.providers.cloudflare.proxy: Set “Proxy status” to “DNS only” — the cloud icon beside it must be grey, not orange.
customDomain.providers.cloudflare.caveat: If the cloud icon stays orange, the padlock will never appear; and nothing will say why.
customDomain.providers.godaddy.open: Open your “Domain Portfolio” page and choose your web address.
customDomain.providers.godaddy.add: Select “Add New Record”, then choose “CNAME” in the “Type” list.
customDomain.providers.godaddy.name: Put the first value below in “Name”.
customDomain.providers.godaddy.value: Put the second value below in “Value”.
customDomain.providers.godaddy.save: Leave “TTL” as it is and select “Save”.
customDomain.providers.godaddy.caveat: If you added more than one at the same time, the button says “Save All Records”.
customDomain.providers.123reg.signIn: Log in to your “123 Reg Control Panel” page.
customDomain.providers.123reg.manage: Beside “Domains”, select “Manage All”, then choose your web address.
customDomain.providers.123reg.name: Put the first value below in “Name”.
customDomain.providers.123reg.value: Put the second value below in “Value”, and add a full stop at the end of it.
customDomain.providers.123reg.caveat: If there is no full stop at the end of the second value, this will not work on 123 Reg.
customDomain.providers.wix.open: Open “Domains”, then click the “Domain Actions” icon beside your web address.
customDomain.providers.wix.add: In the “CNAME (Aliases)” section, click “+ Add Record”, then click “Got it”.
customDomain.providers.wix.name: Put the first value below in “Host Name”.
customDomain.providers.wix.value: Put the second value below in “Value”.
customDomain.providers.wix.save: Click “Save”, then click “Save Changes” in the window that appears.
customDomain.providers.wix.caveat: If your web address is not held at Wix but only pointed at it, Wix cannot make this change — whoever holds it must do it.
customDomain.instructionsEmail.subject: One DNS record to add — {truckName} schedule page
customDomain.instructionsEmail.introAt: {truckName} — we are putting its live schedule at the address {address}; for that, one DNS record must be added to our domain on {provider}.
customDomain.instructionsEmail.introHold: {truckName} — we are putting its live schedule at the address {address}; for that, one DNS record must be added to our domain with whoever holds our domain.
